title: The account name is the only account control in admin, and it leaves admin for the participant profile
what_happens: Top right shows the organizer's name in small spaced caps. It links to /me, the participant profile: a different grid, the EN/ES switch is back, it lists their own conversations, and there is no link back to admin. Log out is only there.
who_hurts: An organizer looking for sign out or their settings ends up on the participant side and has to use the browser back button.
suggested_fix: On /admin pages, have the name open a small menu (Profile, Log out), or add an 'Admin' link on /me for organizers. Smallest: an 'Admin' link on /me when the user is an organizer.
owners_call: Is sending organizers to the participant profile intended?
